prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray (airbrush) tan or UV tanning beds/booths? Preferences—price, proximity to downtown Pleasanton, or brand-name equipment—will change the best choice.

I can’t look up current local reviews from here, but I can:
- Tell you how to pick the best salon (what to check and questions to ask).
- Suggest a shortlist of what to look for when comparing nearby salons.
- If you want, tell me your zip code or a cross-street and I’ll walk you through how to find and compare the top-rated salons on Google/Yelp and what to watch for in reviews.

Quick guidance while you decide:
- Safety: spray tans are far safer than UV beds (no skin-cancer risk). If you use UV, limit sessions, use eye protection, and follow provider instructions.
- Look for: recent 4+ star reviews, photos of real results, certified technicians, clean facility, patch test policy (for spray tans), up-to-date equipment, clear pricing/membership options, good customer service.
- Ask the salon: what brands/solutions they use (reputable bronzers), technician certification, estimated results/duration, aftercare instructions, and allergy/patch test policy.

Tell me which type you want and your preferred area and I’ll help you narrow it down.
